correctness.rationale: PASS: fixed-target renewal transform Φ_p(s)=(r+s)p^sqrt(1+s/r)/(s+r p^sqrt(1+s/r)) with p=e^-kR, and p~Beta(a,1), imply beta-geometric reset counts. For X_p=rpT, Φ_p(srp)→(1+s)^-1 and MGF at θrp is ≤1/(1-θ), yielding uniform exponential survival envelope. Dominated-convergence integral over v=rtp gives Γ(a+1)(rt)^-a tail, all-real moment cutoff q<a. Stopped Poisson martingale has E[(N-rT)^2|p]=rE[T|p]=(1-p)/p, forcing scaled count/time locking; conditional posterior density factors v^(a-1)e^(-v-e) into Gamma(a) and independent Exp(1). Recomputed a=2 beta counts P(N=0)=2/3,P(N=1)=1/6, and scaled Laplace at p=e^-10,e^-20,e^-30 →.5. No claim of independent N and T at finite t.
